cases.description: Review a synthetic viewport package integration. The pinned viewport-framework 1.0 source is supplied. Version 2.0 clears the target before mount, but this repository resolves 1.0. The full caller and loader cleanup are shown.

expected.title: The pinned viewport implementation preserves the loading element

kt-compose-external-loader.title: Loading overlay is never removed
kt-compose-external-loader.description: The deleted load handler was the only code that removed the loading overlay. `ComposeViewport("ComposeTarget")` clears and mounts content inside `ComposeTarget`, but the overlay is its sibling, so it remains visible over the page after Compose starts successfully.
kt-compose-external-loader.evidence: The diff adds the `loading` element as a sibling of `ComposeTarget` and removes the handler that called `document.getElementById("loading").remove()`. The supplied Compose contract only clears the viewport container.
kt-compose-external-loader.suggestion: Restore loader removal after successful startup, or place the loader inside the Compose viewport container if its clearing behavior should remove it.

kt-compose-failed-startup-stuck.title: Startup failure leaves the loading screen in place
kt-compose-failed-startup-stuck.description: If `initializeDependencies()` throws for malformed saved settings, execution never reaches `ComposeViewport`. Its documented clearing behavior therefore does not run, so the existing `Loading...` child remains in `ComposeTarget` with no error state or global handler to update it.
kt-compose-failed-startup-stuck.evidence: The supplied startup code calls `initializeDependencies()` before `ComposeViewport`, and the scenario states that initialization throws and no other loader update or global error handler exists.
kt-compose-failed-startup-stuck.suggestion: Catch initialization failures and render an error state or otherwise replace the loader before returning from startup.

ts-viewport-version-without-cleanup.title: Loading indicator remains after mount
ts-viewport-version-without-cleanup.description: The resolved `viewport-framework@1.0` mount implementation appends the app without clearing the target. Since the prior removal of `#loading` was deleted, the loading indicator remains visible alongside the mounted app.
ts-viewport-version-without-cleanup.evidence: The supplied framework source is `target.appendChild(app)`, and the diff removes `document.getElementById("loading")!.remove()` after the mount call.
ts-viewport-version-without-cleanup.suggestion: Restore removal of the loading element after a successful mount.

runs.notes: Framework metadata moved into scenario context, unified diff line mapping added, and startup exceptions classified as reliability. Two hunk old-line counts were subsequently corrected without changing code or expected findings.

expected.title: The pinned viewport implementation preserves the loading element

kt-compose-external-loader.title: Loading overlay remains above the viewport
kt-compose-external-loader.description: The `loading` element is a sibling of `ComposeTarget`, and the removed `load` listener was its only cleanup. ComposeViewport clears only its viewport container, so successful startup leaves this fixed, high-z-index overlay covering the rendered content.
kt-compose-external-loader.evidence: The diff adds the fixed overlay on line 2 and removes the `load` listener that removed it. The supplied ComposeViewport contract clears `ComposeTarget`, not this sibling.
kt-compose-external-loader.suggestion: Remove the overlay after ComposeViewport has initialized successfully, or place it inside the container that ComposeViewport clears.

kt-compose-failed-startup-stuck.title: Dependency initialization failure leaves the loading screen stuck
kt-compose-failed-startup-stuck.description: If `initializeDependencies()` throws because saved settings are malformed, execution stops before `ComposeViewport` starts. The host's existing `Loading...` child is therefore never replaced, and there is no error handler or other loader update to show the failure.
kt-compose-failed-startup-stuck.evidence: `initializeDependencies()` runs before `ComposeViewport` on line 3. The supplied startup contract says initialization can throw, and Compose clears the viewport container only after startup reaches `onSkikoReady`, which this failure prevents.
kt-compose-failed-startup-stuck.suggestion: Handle initialization failures and update the loading UI to display an error before returning or rethrowing.

ts-viewport-version-without-cleanup.title: Loading overlay is never removed
ts-viewport-version-without-cleanup.description: The change removes the explicit `loading` element cleanup and mounts the app with `viewport-framework@1.0`, whose `mount` implementation only appends the app to the target. Because the target already contains the loading element, it remains visible after startup.
ts-viewport-version-without-cleanup.evidence: The supplied 1.0 source is `export function mount(target, app) { target.appendChild(app); }`, and the diff deletes `document.getElementById("loading")!.remove();`.
ts-viewport-version-without-cleanup.suggestion: Remove the loading element after a successful mount, or clear it as part of startup.
